title: Concept: Loan outstanding figure in a response
description: A loan outstanding balance, principal due or EMI amount in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The figure describes the customer's debt position and repayment capacity, and it is exposed wherever the loan summary is rendered without masking.
applicability: Loan summary, credit-limit and pre-approved-offer pages.
risk: Debt position supports targeted loan fraud and predatory offers, and it is regulated personal data.
